From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Offer prep: band elevation & comp sign-off for Margot Hansen

Team —

Quick background: Margot (ex-Lead Infra at BrightLayer) completed on-site yesterday. Strong match for Senior Inference Engineer (IC4) but interviewing panel recommended elevating to IC5 based on systems design and shipping inference runtimes. She’s requesting an expedite (two-week notice).

Proposed comp (market + retention mix):
- Base: $225,000
- Target OTE: $255,000 (10% bonus target + RSU refresh cadence)
- Signing bonus proposed: $25,000

Current band for IC5 here maps to base $210–230k. This comp is at top-of-band + sign-on. I’ve attached resume and comp matrix. Karthik flagged that manager-level signoff is OK but we need VP/comp approval for the band elevation + signing bonus.

Ask: Laura / Mina — can you confirm we have budget flexibility to approve this as an exception and route for exec sign-off? If yes, I’ll ask Lauren to sign off so we can issue offer within 48 hours.

Attachments: Margot_Hansen_Resume.pdf, comp_approval_matrix.csv

Thanks,
Jonas
Sr. Director, GTM Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer prep: band elevation & comp-signoff for Margot Hansen

Jonas —

Thanks for the write-up and attachments. I pulled Margot’s resume into the comp matrix and ran a quick comp bench against similar hires in 2025–2026. Notes:
- IC5 base band: $210k–$230k (standard).
- Total comp proposed sits ~7% above our recent IC5 hires on average but within reason for high-impact infra hires in SF.
- Signing bonus of $25k is above our typical practice but acceptable as a one-time retention lever given notice timing.

Mina and I can greenlight a band exception (internal approval) provided Lauren signs off on the final packet. We’ll prepare a short exception memo for exec review and include suggested negotiation guardrails (counter ceilings, start-date flexibility, RSU vesting schedule).

I’ll draft the exception memo and attach the offer_template_Redwood.xlsx for your review. ETA: I can have the memo + updated matrix by end of day.

Laura
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
